General Specs:
Approximate Square Footage: 		2,278
Mezzanine Rated Capacity: 		30 psf T.L. / 20 psf L.L. 
Engineering Standards: 		L/360
Deck Height:			19' - 6" 
Approximate Crossmember Spacing:	5' 11" c/c 

Structure Details:
All sizing of structural members were provided by AVM with directions to grout base plates with epoxy anchors 
All connection details, including moment and shear, were provided by AVM
Includes standard tubular columns with base plates sized to minimize foundation loading (pre-drilled for 4 anchors)
Standard structural WF beam frame design with a combination of bolted and welded connections.
PWI Packages include all anchoring and assembly hardware 
All structural steel will be primed gray with the exception of slip critical connections
Includes rated capacity decals 

No Bracing: I, the customer, require this mezzanine to be completely unbraced and all lateral loads need to be accounted for in the footer/foundation design. This will require heavier header steel and cross members along with heavier moment connections and columns. This option provides open traffic patterns under the mezzanine. I understand & acknowledge this will add significant cost in structural and footer upgrades.
